title: 10. Exercises: Topic 2: Inheritance - Exercises
summary: Complete all 10 exercises below. Each exercise builds upon the concepts learned in Topic 2.
objectives: Solve the Topic 2: Inheritance - Exercises exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercise Instructions
sections.body: Complete all 10 exercises below. Each exercise builds upon the concepts learned in Topic 2. Write your solutions in separate Python files and test them thoroughly.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Animal Kingdom Hierarchy
sections.body:
Create a comprehensive animal hierarchy system:
- **Base Class**: `Animal` with attributes: name, species, age, habitat
- **Subclasses**: 
  - `Mammal` (with fur_color, gestation_period)
  - `Bird` (with wing_span, can_fly)
  - `Fish` (with fin_count, water_type)
- **Methods**: 
  - `make_sound()` (overridden in each subclass)
  - `move()` (overridden in each subclass)
  - `get_info()` (inherited and extended)
- Create multiple animals of each type and demonstrate inheritance

sections.title: Exercise 2: University Course Management System
sections.body:
Build a course management system with inheritance:
- **Base Class**: `Course` with attributes: course_id, name, credits, instructor
- **Subclasses**:
  - `LectureCourse` (with room_number, max_students)
  - `LabCourse` (with lab_equipment, safety_requirements)
  - `OnlineCourse` (with platform, meeting_link)
- **Methods**:
  - `enroll_student()` (different logic for each type)
  - `get_schedule()` (overridden for each type)
  - `calculate_fee()` (different pricing for each type)
- Implement student enrollment and course management

sections.title: Exercise 3: Payment System with Multiple Inheritance
sections.body:
Create a payment system using multiple inheritance:
- **Base Classes**:
  - `PaymentMethod` (with payment_id, amount, status)
  - `Secure` (with encryption_type, security_level)
  - `Fast` (with processing_time, priority)
- **Combined Classes**:
  - `CreditCard` (inherits from PaymentMethod, Secure)
  - `DigitalWallet` (inherits from PaymentMethod, Fast)
  - `Cryptocurrency` (inherits from PaymentMethod, Secure, Fast)
- **Methods**:
  - `process_payment()` (different implementation for each)
  - `validate_transaction()` (inherited from Secure)
  - `get_processing_info()` (inherited from Fast)
- Demonstrate MRO and multiple inheritance

sections.title: Exercise 4: Employee Management with Multilevel Inheritance
sections.body:
Design an employee management system with multilevel inheritance:
- **Base Class**: `Person` (name, age, contact_info)
- **Level 1**: `Employee` (inherits from Person, adds employee_id, salary)
- **Level 2**: `Manager` (inherits from Employee, adds department, subordinates)
- **Level 3**: `SeniorManager` (inherits from Manager, adds region, budget)
- **Methods**:
  - `calculate_salary()` (different bonuses at each level)
  - `get_authority_level()` (returns hierarchy level)
  - `manage_team()` (different capabilities at each level)
- Create a complete organizational hierarchy

sections.title: Exercise 5: Vehicle Rental System
sections.body:
Build a vehicle rental system with inheritance:
- **Base Class**: `Vehicle` (make, model, year, daily_rate)
- **Subclasses**:
  - `Car` (num_doors, fuel_type, trunk_space)
  - `Motorcycle` (engine_size, has_sidecar, helmet_included)
  - `Truck` (cargo_capacity, towing_capacity, commercial_license_required)
- **Methods**:
  - `calculate_rental_cost()` (different rates and fees)
  - `check_availability()` (different criteria for each type)
  - `perform_maintenance()` (different maintenance schedules)
- Implement rental booking and return functionality

sections.title: Exercise 6: Media Library with Abstract Base Classes
sections.body:
Create a media library system using abstract base classes:
- **Abstract Base Class**: `Media` (with abstract methods)
- **Concrete Classes**:
  - `Book` (author, isbn, pages, genre)
  - `Movie` (director, duration, rating, genre)
  - `Music` (artist, album, duration, genre)
- **Abstract Methods**:
  - `get_details()` (must be implemented by each subclass)
  - `calculate_rental_fee()` (different logic for each type)
  - `get_recommendations()` (based on genre and preferences)
- Implement a complete media management system

sections.title: Exercise 7: Banking System with Method Overriding
sections.body:
Develop a comprehensive banking system:
- **Base Class**: `Account` (account_number, holder_name, balance)
- **Subclasses**:
  - `SavingsAccount` (interest_rate, minimum_balance)
  - `CheckingAccount` (overdraft_limit, monthly_fee)
  - `BusinessAccount` (business_type, transaction_limit)
- **Overridden Methods**:
  - `withdraw()` (different rules for each account type)
  - `add_interest()` (different interest calculations)
  - `get_monthly_statement()` (different formats)
- Implement transaction tracking and account management

sections.title: Exercise 8: Restaurant Menu System with Mixins
sections.body:
Create a restaurant menu system using mixins:
- **Base Class**: `MenuItem` (name, price, description)
- **Mixin Classes**:
  - `SpicyMixin` (spice_level, heat_warning)
  - `VegetarianMixin` (vegetarian_certified, vegan_option)
  - `SeasonalMixin` (season_available, seasonal_price)
- **Combined Classes**:
  - `SpicyDish` (inherits from MenuItem, SpicyMixin)
  - `VegetarianDish` (inherits from MenuItem, VegetarianMixin)
  - `SeasonalVegetarianDish` (inherits from MenuItem, VegetarianMixin, SeasonalMixin)
- **Methods**:
  - `get_preparation_instructions()` (different for each type)
  - `calculate_final_price()` (applies seasonal discounts)
  - `get_dietary_info()` (combines mixin information)

sections.title: Exercise 9: Game Character System
sections.body:
Design a game character system with inheritance:
- **Base Class**: `Character` (name, health, level, experience)
- **Subclasses**:
  - `Warrior` (weapon_type, armor_class, strength)
  - `Mage` (spell_book, mana, intelligence)
  - `Archer` (bow_type, accuracy, dexterity)
- **Methods**:
  - `attack()` (different damage calculations)
  - `defend()` (different defense mechanisms)
  - `level_up()` (different stat improvements)
  - `use_special_ability()` (unique to each class)
- Implement combat system and character progression

sections.title: Exercise 10: E-commerce Product Catalog with Inheritance
sections.body:
Build an e-commerce product catalog:
- **Base Class**: `Product` (product_id, name, price, category)
- **Subclasses**:
  - `Electronics` (warranty_period, power_consumption, brand)
  - `Clothing` (size, material, care_instructions)
  - `Books` (author, isbn, publication_date, genre)
- **Methods**:
  - `calculate_shipping()` (different for each category)
  - `apply_discount()` (different discount rules)
  - `get_product_details()` (formatted differently for each type)
  - `check_availability()` (different inventory management)
- Implement shopping cart and order processing

sections.title: Additional Challenges (Optional)
sections.body:
### Challenge 1: Diamond Problem
Create a class hierarchy that demonstrates the diamond problem:
- Class A with method `method()`
- Classes B and C inherit from A and override `method()`
- Class D inherits from both B and C
- Resolve the diamond problem using proper MRO understanding

### Challenge 2: Interface Implementation
Create abstract base classes that act as interfaces:
- `Readable` interface with abstract methods
- `Writable` interface with abstract methods
- `Searchable` interface with abstract methods
- Implement classes that use multiple interfaces

### Challenge 3: Factory Pattern with Inheritance
Implement a factory pattern using inheritance:
- Abstract `AnimalFactory` class
- Concrete factories for different animal types
- Use inheritance to create appropriate animal objects
- Demonstrate polymorphic behavior

sections.title: Submission Guidelines
sections.body:
1. Create separate Python files for each exercise
2. Include proper documentation and comments
3. Test all inheritance scenarios
4. Ensure proper use of `super()` function
5. Demonstrate method overriding and MRO
6. Add error handling where appropriate
